speech.heard: In Syria, 11.4% of females are in their early 20s, in Belarus, 4.3%. East Timor follows right behind at 10.6% of females in that age group. On the low end, China has 5.2% and Japan sits at 4.7%. Eastern Europe drops lower, Latvia has 4.4%, Poland 4.4% and Belarus 4.3%. India sits higher at 8.7% with two times the share of Belarus. What share of females in your country are in their early 20s?
